arxiv-2012-06247.title: Some subcritical estimates for the ℓ p \ell^{p} -improving problem for discrete curves
arxiv-2012-06247.creator: Spyridon Dendrinos, Kevin Hughes, Marco Vitturi
arxiv-2012-06247.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Spyridon Dendrinos, Kevin Hughes, Marco Vitturi. We apply Christ’s method of refinements to the ℓ p \ell^{p} -improving problem for discrete averages 𝒜 N \mathcal{A}_{N} along polynomial curves in ℤ d \mathbb{Z}^{d} . Combined with certain elementary estimates for the number of solutions to certain special systems of diophantine equations, we obtain some restricted weak-type p → p ′ p\to p^{\prime} estimates for the averages 𝒜 N \mathcal{A}_{N} in the subcritical regime.

arxiv-2101-10511.title: Generic Event Boundary Detection: A Benchmark for Event Segmentation
arxiv-2101-10511.creator: Mike Zheng Shou, Stan Weixian Lei, Weiyao Wang, Deepti Ghadiyaram, Matt Feiszli
arxiv-2101-10511.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel task together with a new benchmark for detecting generic, taxonomy-free event boundaries that segment a whole video into chunks. Conventional work in temporal video segmentation and action detection focuses on localizing pre-defined action categories and thus does not scale to generic videos.

arxiv-2104-04564.title: Can ordered precursors promote the nucleation of solid solutions?
arxiv-2104-04564.creator: Caroline Desgranges, Jerome Delhommelle
arxiv-2104-04564.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Caroline Desgranges, Jerome Delhommelle. Crystallization often proceeds through successive stages that lead to a gradual increase in organization. Using molecular simulation, we determine the nucleation pathway for solid solutions of copper and gold. We identify a new nucleation mechanism (liquid → \to L ​ 1 2 L1_{2} precursor → \to solid solution), involving a chemically ordered intermediate that is more organized than the end product.

arxiv-2412-10907.title: Energy-resolved pulse profile changes in V 0332+53: Indications of wings in the cyclotron absorption line profile
arxiv-2412-10907.creator: Antonino D’Aì, Dimitrios K. Maniadakis, Carlo Ferrigno, Elena Ambrosi, Ekaterina Sokolova-Lapa, Giancarlo Cusumano, Peter A. Becker, Luciano Burderi, Melania Del Santo, Tiziana Di Salvo, Felix Fürst, Rosario Iaria, Peter Kretschmar, Valentina La Parola, Christian Malacaria, Ciro Pinto, Fabio Pintore
arxiv-2412-10907.description: Abstract Aims. We aim to investigate the energy-resolved pulse profile changes of the accreting X-ray pulsar V 0332+53 focusing in the cyclotron line energy range, using the full set of available NuSTAR observations. Methods. We applied a tailored pipeline to study the energy dependence of the pulse profiles and to build the pulsed fraction spectra (PFS) for the different observations.

arxiv-2509-00561.title: FreeTalk :A plug-and-play and black-box defense against speech synthesis attacks
arxiv-2509-00561.creator: Yuwen Pu, Zhou Feng, Chunyi Zhou, Jiahao Chen, Chunqiang Hu, Haibo Hu, Shouling Ji
arxiv-2509-00561.description: Abstract Recently, speech assistant and speech verification have been used in many fields (such as smart home, finance, speech translation, and audio navigation), which brings much benefit and convenience for us. However, when we enjoy these speech applications, our speech may be collected by attackers for speech synthesis.

arxiv-2512-03960.title: Aggregating maximal cliques in real-world graphs
arxiv-2512-03960.creator: Noga Alon, Sabyasachi Basu, Shweta Jain, Haim Kaplan, Jakub Łącki, Blair D. Sullivan
arxiv-2512-03960.description: Abstract . Maximal clique enumeration is a fundamental graph mining task, but its utility is often limited by computational intractability and highly redundant output. pmc-10650669.creator: Linxia Wu, Xinlu Wang, Jianqiang Hao, Ning Zhu, Meng Wang
pmc-10650669.description: Strawberry is the most consumed berry fruit worldwide due to its unique aroma and high nutritive value. This fruit is also an important source of phenolic compounds. pmc-11366172.description: Malignant tumors remain a primary cause of human mortality. pmc-11609910.creator: J Alam, A Joshi, N Mir, N Chawla, S Sagar
pmc-11609910.description: Women in India, particularly those with amputation, face significant challenges, including but not limited to, unequal prosthetic access and satisfaction, societal discrimination, and the physical and emotional consequences of amputation. pmc-13656615.creator: MingJing Yu, YuLing Xiao, Ya Liu, ZhongHao Wang, Haixia Zhou, YongJiang Tang
pmc-13656615.description: BackgroundOpportunistic infections caused by uncommon intracellular pathogens can serve as important clues to underlying immune dysfunction.Case presentationWe report a 57-year-old male who presented with chronic cough, dyspnea, fever, and weight loss. Despite empirical anti-tuberculosis and broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy, his condition deteriorated.

pmc-13700314.title: Factors associated with suicidal ideation among Malaysian university students: Dynamics of mental health vulnerabilities and protective resources
pmc-13700314.creator: Shin Ling Wu, Pei Nee Mah, Soon Aun Tan, Jia Yuin Fam, Chin Choo Yap
pmc-13700314.description: BackgroundSuicidal ideation is a major public health concern among university students, especially in recent years. Guided by Beck’s cognitive model of suicidal behaviour and the dual-factor model of mental health, this study examined the association between mental health vulnerabilities (i.e., depression, anxiety, stress and pessimism), protective resources (i.e., social support and optimism) and suicidal ideation among Malaysian university students.
